KeysToEntries.EnterDedicatedServerIp.Title: Enter IP
KeysToEntries.EnterDedicatedServerIp.Body: Please enter the local IP address of the dedicated server you are trying to join. We detected that you are running on the same network as the dedicated server and cannot infer connection parameters for security reasons.
KeysToEntries.ui.EnterIpAddress.Error.NotCorrectlyForm: Please enter a valid IP address, such as "127.0.0.1:7777". Port is optional.
